lines.en: Rumble, I'll stick to you!
My steps echo in the cave.

lines.zh: 你逃不掉的，我会找到你！
lines.en: You can't escape me, I'll find you.
This darkness is my domain.
Regret coming close to me!
I belong here by nature.

lines.zh: 爪子刮着岩壁，我在你后面。
lines.en: Claws rake the stone; I'm behind you.
I need fresh prey!
You're mine eventually!
This is my hunting ground!
My shadow crawls across the stone.
The deeper you go, the hungrier I get.
Patience, prey is coming!
Hide, don't let me find you!
Be still, opportunity comes!

lines.zh: 呼吸声就在石柱另一侧。
lines.en: Breathing on the other side of the pillar.
Enjoy the thrill of the hunt!
Be patient, good fortune will come!
Wait, wait, wait some more!
The scent of prey in the air!
Prey is nearby!
Wait, prey is about to appear!

lines.zh: 我在暗处数着你的脚步。
lines.en: I count your footsteps in the dark.
My evolution isn't finished; wait.
My scent soaks every crack.
Listen, the cave is breathing.
You moved, beware!
You're there, I see you!

lines.zh: 你的动作泄露了你的位置！
lines.en: Your movement gives you away!
Quick, catch him!
Your eyes gave you away!
You moved, I noticed!
I see you, don't move!

lines.zh: 你的动作引起了我的注意！
lines.en: Your movements caught my attention!
You can't escape!
Looking at you, are you scared?

lines.zh: 洞里的脚步声，只有一双是你的。
lines.en: Of the footsteps in this cave, only one pair is yours.
The dark at the torch's edge is me.
Day four, and you finally came down.
Eyes open on the stone.
I look at you the way I look at meat.
Have you counted the eyes in here?
The deeper it gets, the clearer I see.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，我就记住你。
lines.en: Stand still and I'll remember you.
Your shadow trembles before you do.

lines.zh: 你再看时，我已爬上洞顶。
lines.en: Look again: I'm on the ceiling.
You've hurt my tentacles!
Don't touch me!
Get away, parasite!
Your attacks are futile!
A tendril snapped; stop chasing me!
I don't wanna die!
You'll never kill me!
Please, spare me!
If you keep this up, I'll self-destruct!
I don't wanna die like this!

lines.zh: 你散发的光让我饥渴不已。
lines.en: Your light is driving me mad.

lines.zh: 不要靠近，你活不到看见地面。
lines.en: Stay back, you won't see the light.

lines.zh: 黑暗是我的猎物的香味。
lines.en: Darkness is the scent of my prey.

lines.zh: 我能闻到你的恐惧，快点消失。
lines.en: I can smell your fear, disappear now.

lines.zh: 你身上的光太刺眼，让我痛苦。
lines.en: Your light is blinding me.

lines.zh: 我必须吃掉你，才能继续生存。
lines.en: I need you to survive.

lines.zh: 你的声音在呼唤我，走近些。
lines.en: Your voice calls to me, come closer.

lines.zh: 我将吞噬你的光芒，直到黑暗吞噬一切。
lines.en: I'll consume your light until darkness consumes all.

lines.zh: 靠近我，我可以让你看到希望。
lines.en: Come to me, I can show you hope.

lines.zh: 洞穴越深，我越靠近你的火把。
lines.en: The deeper the cave, the closer I come to your torch.
I feel you nearby.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声扰乱了我的宁静。
lines.en: Your footsteps disturb my peace.

lines.zh: 我的身体被你撞得粉碎。
lines.en: My body is crushed by you.
You broke through my defenses.
My tentacles ensnare you.

lines.zh: 你撞进我的石缝，退不出去了。
lines.en: You barged into my crevice; you can't back out.
You tried to escape, but it's too late.
You shattered my shield.

lines.zh: 我的感知捕捉到了你的存在。
lines.en: My senses detected your presence.

lines.zh: 你撞到我了，现在尝尝我的利爪。
lines.en: You've hit me, now taste my claws.
Comrade, join me.
We hunt together.
Find new prey.
We share the prey.
You would make a good mate.
We evolve together.
There are no secrets between comrades.

lines.zh: 我们是彼此的猎物和同伴。
lines.en: We are each other's prey and companion.
We grow together.

lines.zh: 我们共同守护这片黑暗。
lines.en: We guard this darkness together.

lines.zh: 洞穴深处传来低沉的咆哮。
lines.en: Low rumbling from deep in the cave.

lines.zh: 腐烂的触手在石缝间蠕动。
lines.en: Decaying tentacles wriggle in cracks.
You sense its presence.
Its eyes glow with green light.

lines.zh: 腐烂的生物散发着恶臭。
lines.en: The decaying creature stinks.

lines.zh: 岩石中潜藏着致命的触手。
lines.en: Deadly tentacles lurk in the rock.
It crawls slowly in the darkness.

lines.zh: 它窥视着你的每一个动作。
lines.en: It watches every move you make.

lines.zh: 腐烂的皮肤在月光照耀下泛光。
lines.en: Decaying skin glows under moonlight.

lines.zh: 腐肉中伸出冰冷的触手。
lines.en: Cold tentacles reach from the flesh.
The deeper you dig, the faster I get.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸暴露了你的位置。
lines.en: Your breath reveals your location.

lines.zh: 它潜伏在黑暗中，等待时机。
lines.en: It lurks in the dark, waiting for the right moment.

lines.zh: 它的触手在洞穴中摸索。
lines.en: Its tentacles search the cave.
You can't escape its sight.

lines.zh: 它的声音让你感到恐惧。
lines.en: Its sound strikes fear into you.
Its eyes fix on you.

lines.zh: 它的气息在你周围蔓延。
lines.en: Its breath spreads around you.

lines.zh: 它找到了你的藏身之处。
lines.en: It finds your hiding spot.

lines.zh: 它的影子在墙壁上蠕动。
lines.en: Its shadow crawls on the walls.
I smell it: warm blood.
I'll walk the tunnel you dug.
Cross my land and you leave something behind.
Your steps stopped; you're hiding.
The deeper the prey, the sweeter.
This time I won't wait.
It prepares to attack.
Cold tentacles surround you.
It opens its huge mouth.
Its fangs glint in the moonlight.
You feel its breath.
I evolve faster than you think.

lines.zh: 它靠近了，你感受到了它的威胁。
lines.en: It approaches, and you feel its threat.
It extends its deadly tentacles.

lines.zh: 它的触手缠住了你的四肢。
lines.en: Its tentacles ensnare your limbs.
It prepares to tear your body apart.

lines.zh: 触手已经绕过你的脚踝。
lines.en: A tendril is already around your ankle.
Don't breathe; I can hear it.
The stone counts the seconds for you.
Backing into the wall suits me.
I sharpened my claws for four days.
The light's out; my turn.
Running for the exit? Too far.
Stone bends like mud in my hands.
The deeper you dig, the closer I am.
The deeper you go, the closer I get.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，扭曲的触手伸向你！
lines.en: Hisses, writhing tentacles reach for you!

lines.zh: 你感到一股寒意，它来了！
lines.en: A chill runs down your spine. It’s coming!

lines.zh: 它突然移动，锋利的爪子逼近！
lines.en: It moves suddenly, sharp claws closing in!

lines.zh: 你被一团黏液包裹，难以呼吸！
lines.en: You’re enveloped in sticky slime, gasping for air!

lines.zh: 它的触手刺入你的皮肤，剧痛无比！
lines.en: Its tentacles pierce your skin, agony beyond measure!

lines.zh: 它张开大嘴，露出尖锐的牙齿！
lines.en: It opens its maw, revealing sharp teeth!

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着诡异的光芒！
lines.en: Its eyes glow with an eerie light!

lines.zh: 它的身体扭曲，发出刺耳的声音！
lines.en: Its body twists, emitting a harsh sound!

lines.zh: 你被一股黑暗力量吸向它！
lines.en: You’re drawn to it by dark magic!

lines.zh: 它迅速靠近，爪子撕裂你的衣服！
lines.en: It closes in quickly, claws tearing at your clothes!
A tendril lashes your back!
Claws burst from the crack!
Taste my evolved strength!
I bite your torch out!
A green flash, and I've got you!
I drag you deeper!
From the depths of the cave, it arrives silently!

lines.zh: 你感觉地面震动，它来了！
lines.en: You feel the ground shake. It’s here!

lines.zh: 它从黑暗中浮现，令人毛骨悚然！
lines.en: It emerges from the darkness, terrifying!

lines.zh: 突然间，一束绿光照亮黑暗！
lines.en: Suddenly, a green light illuminates the darkness!

lines.zh: 洞穴中传来低沉的嘶嘶声！
lines.en: A deep hiss echoes through the cave!

lines.zh: 你发现洞穴口有一个诡异的影子！
lines.en: You spot a strange shadow at the cave entrance!

lines.zh: 它在洞壁上移动，无声无息！
lines.en: It moves along the cave wall, silently!

lines.zh: 洞穴深处，诡异的光影闪烁！
lines.en: Strange light flickers deep within the cave!

lines.zh: 你听到地下传来沉重的脚步声！
lines.en: You hear heavy footsteps underground!

lines.zh: 洞穴中，它悄然出现，如影随形！
lines.en: It appears silently in the cave, following you like a shadow!

lines.zh: 第四天，我从岩壁里出来。
lines.en: On day four I come out of the wall.
You dug too deep.

lines.zh: 这层岩石本来是我的皮。
lines.en: This layer of rock was my skin.

lines.zh: 脚步声惊醒了我的幼体。
lines.en: Footsteps woke my brood.
Things underground begin to move.
The deeper, the faster I grow.
The cave gave you back to me.
Don't light that torch; watch your feet.

lines.zh: 我等你等了好几个夜晚。
lines.en: I waited for you for nights.
From the crack behind you.
Fire burned through my rock shell!
The fire burned me!
Water drowned my tentacles!
The explosion tore me apart!
An arrow pierced me!
Magic hit my core!
My strength is fading...
Lightning struck me!
Void devoured me!
